SELECT [regnak_prodazhi].[_Period] AS [period],
       [regnak_prodazhi].[_RecorderRRef] AS [recorder],
       [regnak_prodazhi].[_RecorderTRef] AS [doc_type],
       [regnak_prodazhi].[_LineNo] AS [line_no],
       [regnak_prodazhi].[_Fld17850RRef] AS [division_id],
       [regnak_prodazhi].[_Fld17853RRef] AS [partner_id],
       [regnak_prodazhi].[_Fld24665] AS [responsible_id],
       [regnak_prodazhi].[_Fld17845RRef] AS [nomenclature_id],
       [regnak_prodazhi].[_Fld17854] AS [quantity],
       [regnak_prodazhi].[_Fld17855] AS [cost],
       [regnak_prodazhi].[_Fld17856] AS [sales_without_discounts],
       [regnak_prodazhi].[_Fld17857] AS [vat],
       [regnak_prodazhi].[_Fld17847_RRRef] AS [order_id]
FROM [UPP_JAN].[dbo].[_AccumRg17844] AS [regnak_prodazhi]
WHERE [regnak_prodazhi].[_Period] BETWEEN '4025-10-01' AND '4025-11-01'
